title: "Why did I say that?" There's a name for it 🕳️ #shorts
description:
"Why did I say that? Why am I like this?" That backward loop has a name: rumination. 🕳️ Psychologist Susan Nolen-Hoeksema linked a habit of replaying problems to a higher risk of depression — because asking "why" over and over feels like digging for answers, but more often it's just digging deeper.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/ez-lXPY79pU
